name: Core scenes and objects
acceptance: Stable identities, component lifetime, scene transaction rollback, nested reuse, clone/reference repair

name: Transforms
acceptance: Parent propagation, signed scale, local/world inversion, reparent preservation, hierarchy-cache invalidation

name: 2D rendering
acceptance: Sprites/regions/tint/order, backend parity, culling, sampling, primitives, resource lifetime

name: Cameras
acceptance: Follow/smoothing/bounds/shake/viewports and coordinate conversion

name: Texture and sprite pipeline
acceptance: Import/reimport identity, atlas regions, missing inputs, cache eviction and persistent references

name: Animation
acceptance: Signed playback, interpolation/events/state transitions, serialized clips, preview and runtime agreement

name: Physics 2D
acceptance: Rust solver bridge, bodies/shapes/joints/queries/events, character collision, units and determinism

name: Tilemaps
acceptance: Layers, paint/fill/selection, atlas transforms, terrain, animation, collision/nav/occlusion and large maps

name: Lighting
acceptance: Light type/mask/attenuation/occlusion, fallback parity; advanced normal-map support needs explicit scope

name: Materials and shaders
acceptance: Real parameter consumption, reusable resources, fallback diagnostics and authored shader restrictions

name: Particles
acceptance: Emitter lifecycle, lifetime curves, deterministic randomness, coordinate spaces and preview

name: Navigation
acceptance: Path queries, obstacle changes, agent movement and actual debug display

name: Audio
acceptance: Loading/cache, pause/stop/loop/pitch/buses, 2D attenuation and scene lifetime

name: Input
acceptance: Named action edges/axes, consumption, remapping, device fallback and project persistence

name: Scripting and logic
acceptance: Rhai lifecycle/host APIs, error isolation, hot reload, graph/event interoperability

name: Signals and events
acceptance: Payload/subscription identity, unsubscribe, destruction and pooled lifetime safety

name: Resources
acceptance: Stable asset references, inheritance, rename/move/delete and dependency closure

name: Game UI
acceptance: HUD/menu controls, anchors/layout/focus/events, exports and pointer/gameplay consumption

name: Text and fonts
acceptance: Font loading/fallback, Unicode, wrapping, alignment and measurement

name: Runtime saves
acceptance: Per-project slots, validation/checksum/migration/rollback; distinct from editor project files

name: Project settings
acceptance: Startup scene, output/window settings, input/physics/audio persistence

name: Build/run/export
acceptance: Play restore/restart, actual assets/player closure, Web/Windows launch; no untested platform claims

name: Debugging
acceptance: Real logs/errors/stacks/breakpoints/live inspection and collision diagnostics

name: Profiling
acceptance: Measured timing/counters, representative loads, scene-cycle resource growth

name: Editor history
acceptance: Atomic edits, drag grouping, cross-resource drafts, undo/redo and reopened projects

name: Editor workflows
acceptance: Selection/reparent/clipboard/drop/search/shortcuts/recovery; dedicated UX phase follows engine

name: Additional 2D capabilities
acceptance: Parallax/path/canvas layers, timers/tasks, seeded math, pooling, localization and extension scope
